parameters.query: SELECT c.id as client_id, c.name, c.linkedin_email, c.linkedin_password, c.content_mode, c.timezone, c.active_hours_start, c.active_hours_end, COALESCE(c.auto_gen_enabled, true) as auto_gen_enabled FROM clients c WHERE c.is_active = true ORDER BY c.created_at ASC;

SELECT
  cel.daily_post_limit,
  COUNT(p.id) as posts_today,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN p.approval_status = 'pending' THEN 1 END) as pending_approvals
FROM client_effective_limits cel
LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.client_id = cel.client_id
  AND p.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE
WHERE cel.client_id = '{{ $json.client_id }}'
GROUP BY cel.daily_post_limit;

INSERT INTO posts (
  client_id, content, topic_pillar, post_format,
  approval_status, post_status, created_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.client_id }}',
  '{{ $json.content.replace(/\\/g, "\\\\").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.topic_pillar }}',
  '{{ $json.post_format }}',
  'pending',
  'draft',
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id, client_id, topic_pillar, post_format, approval_status;
